# Pinned firmware library notices

These are unmodified license files copied from the 11 pinned library checkouts
used for the review build. `inventory.json` records names, versions, upstream
URLs and text hashes. They are an inventory, not a legal clearance of the final
binary. Arduino core/ESP-IDF notices, transitive components, fonts/resources and
provenance of added modules still need distribution review. The original root
LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md are retained; their historical clean-room and
provenance assertions have not been independently established by this audit.
